title: Lift a spare valve onto HRSG 1's roof

p: Lift a spare valve on its pallet from the drop zone at grade onto HRSG 1's roof with the roof's monorail hoist (
): hook on at grade, hoist, bring it in over the roof, set it down and unhook. The pendant's buttons run a motion only while they are held.

text: ) stops at the end of the beam, over the drop zone.

p: The beam runs 3 m past the roof's edge: a load lifted there clears the casing, and the barriered zone under it keeps everyone out of its way.

text: Release Out, then hold Down: lower the hook (
) to the valve's slings at grade.
Release Down and, at the hook, close its latch (

p: The latch keeps the slings from jumping off the hook when the chain goes slack.

text: Back at the pendant on the roof, hold Up: hoist the valve until it clears the roof's handrail. Watch the load cell (

p: The hoist is rated 2,000 kg: a heavier load stops it as it starts to lift, and the load cell shows what hangs on the hook.

text: Release Up, then hold In: bring the valve in over the roof, 3 m from its edge.

p: The trolley moves a hooked load only once it is clear of the handrail: it would drag it into the roof's edge.

text: Release In, then hold Down: set the valve down on the roof.
Release Down and open the hook's latch (

p: The latch opens only with the load resting: a hanging load must never be unhooked.

text: Hold Up to raise the empty hook clear of the valve, then release.
